title: Work IQ: Microsoft IQ as a unified intelligence layer for agents
summary: The roadmap facts, documented background controls and corrected spending-policy API are supported. The summary should narrow its billing shorthand to custom and third-party agents; the body already gives that qualification. The planned release's defaults, licensing and relationship to existing Work IQ remain unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The Microsoft IQ documentation hub describes Microsoft IQ as a unified intelligence layer for enterprise AI.
claims.quote: Microsoft IQ is a unified intelligence layer for enterprise AI—one where every agent and Copilot interaction is grounded in a shared, continuously evolving understanding of the organization.

claims.claim: The hub brings together four capabilities: Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ and Web IQ.
claims.quote: Microsoft IQ brings together four interconnected capabilities:

claims.claim: The hub describes Work IQ as understanding how employees work, including people, collaboration and workflows.
claims.quote: Work IQ provides live understanding of how employees work, with context on people, collaboration, and workflows.

claims.claim: The hub describes Fabric IQ as providing the live state of the business.
claims.quote: Fabric IQ provides the live state of the business, so agents understand business entities and their relationships, properties, actions, and rules.

claims.claim: The hub describes Foundry IQ as providing curated institutional knowledge.
claims.quote: Foundry IQ provides curated institutional knowledge on the context of policies, authoritative documents, and reusable knowledge bases.

claims.claim: The hub describes Web IQ as providing fresh intelligence from the web.
claims.quote: Web IQ provides AI systems and agents with fresh, real-world intelligence from across the web.

claims.quote: Write operations are on by default. Your organization's permissions and policies still apply.
